text.tspan: THE ANATOMY OF A CITED NUMBER
What a cited measurement establishes — and what it leaves open
a score · a proof · a figure
THE HEADLINE KEEPS THE FIRST — AND DROPS THE OTHER THREE

THE NUMBER IS RARELY THE PROBLEM. THE MISSING INSTRUMENT IS.
